title: The Vanished Spinning Top
intro: The gold-painted spinning top, the workshop's prize creation, has disappeared from its velvet cushion just before the toymakers' open day.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was in the back room with the sewing machines, honest.

suspects.name: Otto
suspects.line: I only came in to check the glue pots. Nothing else.

suspects.name: Mabel
suspects.line: I was sanding the rocking horse all morning. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Rafi
suspects.line: Top? What top? I've been wrapping parcels since nine.

suspects.name: Sol
suspects.line: My knees are too old for sneaking about, young lady.

clues.text: Fresh footprints lead straight up the path, but the gate log shows nobody on foot signed in past noon. The culprit did not walk here.
A red bandana was found tucked under the glue pot, and its owner was seen at the bench all afternoon. The culprit is not the person who wears a red bandana.
Sticky gold-tinted fingerprints smeared the glue pot lid, and a glue-stained thumb print is still visible on the lid's rim. The culprit has glue-stained hands.
Muddy tram tickets were found in the bin by the stop, and the tram's last run was the one that left the depot. The culprit came in on a tram.
